guard_recommendation:
# Guard Recommendation — Local vs CI Deploy (Input untuk ADR nanti)

## Context
Spike local-deploy-race membuktikan runtime.OperationLock flock mencegah dual-active saat local dan CI deploy bersamaan ke target yang sama. Satu pemenang deterministik, yang kalah ditolak dengan error jelas, state /.anvil tidak corrupt, retry tidak duplicate.

## Rekomendasi Guard

### 1. Dev Environment (allow local)
- anvil deploy --target dev boleh dari local tanpa gate tambahan.
- Rationale: dev butuh iterasi cepat, risiko overwrite rendah, rollback first-class tetap tersedia.
- Guard minimal: warning log "deploying from local to dev" + audit trail (user, host, artifact_id).
- Tidak perlu confirm prompt di dev, tapi tetap enforce locking (flock) agar concurrent local+CI tidak race.

### 2. Staging Environment (soft gate)
- anvil deploy --target staging boleh dari local atau CI, tapi harus eksplisit flag --confirm atau ANVIL_ALLOW_LOCAL_STAGING=1.
- Jika CI terdeteksi (env CI=true atau GITHUB_ACTIONS), local deploy ke staging ditolak kecuali allowlist.
- Pesan error: "staging deploy from local requires --confirm (concurrent risk) — use CI pipeline or set allowlist".

### 3. Prod Environment (require allowlist + confirm prompt)
- anvil deploy --target prod hanya via CI secara default. Local langsung ditolak.
- Allowlist: anvil.yaml / server.targets[prod].allowLocalDeploys: [user@host fingerprint] atau ANVIL_PROD_ALLOW_LOCAL=true (opsional, explicit).
- Jika allowlist terpenuhi, tetap require interactive confirm prompt: Confirm deploy local artifact <id> to prod? (yes/no): — timeout 30s, default no.
- Non-interactive (CI) bypass prompt tapi tetap audit + locking.
- Audit: prod deploy log harus capture deployer identity (SSH key fingerprint / CI job url) untuk traceability.

### 4. Mekanisme Teknis (untuk ADR)
- Enforce via ServerReleaseCoordinator.Install/Activate sudah pakai runtime.OperationLock flock — tidak perlu perubahan.
- Tambahkan anvil deploy pre-flight check: if target.env == "prod" && !isCI && !isAllowlisted(user) { deny or prompt }
- Idempotency: Install sudah reject duplicate artifact_id already installed — retry aman.
- State dumps (runtime-state.json + .anvil/state/releases/*.json) tetap authoritative; observability anvil status query via server.QueryLifecycleStatus (read-only, ADR-036).

### 5. Evidence Spike
- Concurrent run logs + state dumps before/after + lock behavior proof ada di spikes/local-deploy-race/evidence/race.log dan summary.json.
- Lock file <installRoot>/runtime-state.lock mode 0600, holder record di runtime-state.json.operation_lock.

## Decision Input untuk ADR
- Opsi A (rekomendasi): dev allow local, prod require allowlist+confirm (hybrid C dari FND).
- Opsi B: preview-only channel (local hanya ke dev/staging, prod CI-only tanpa allowlist).
- Perlu ADR baru adr:local-deploy-guard sebelum anvil deploy masuk Planning->Execution.
